# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficients
# Pearson correlation: r = cov(X, Y) / (std(X) * std(Y))

# Prepare the data
neg_scores = abc_news_df['neg'].values
neu_scores = abc_news_df['neu'].values
pos_scores = abc_news_df['pos'].values
article_lengths = abc_news_df['article_length'].values

n = len(abc_news_df)
print(f"Number of samples: {n}")

# Calculate means
neg_mean = np.mean(neg_scores)
neu_mean = np.mean(neu_scores)
pos_mean = np.mean(pos_scores)
length_mean = np.mean(article_lengths)

print(f"\nMeans:")
print(f"neg mean: {neg_mean}")
print(f"neu mean: {neu_mean}")
print(f"pos mean: {pos_mean}")
print(f"article_length mean: {length_mean}")

# Calculate covariances
cov_neg_length = np.sum((neg_scores - neg_mean) * (article_lengths - length_mean)) / n
cov_neu_length = np.sum((neu_scores - neu_mean) * (article_lengths - length_mean)) / n
cov_pos_length = np.sum((pos_scores - pos_mean) * (article_lengths - length_mean)) / n

print(f"\nCovariances:")
print(f"cov(neg, length): {cov_neg_length}")
print(f"cov(neu, length): {cov_neu_length}")
print(f"cov(pos, length): {cov_pos_length}")

# Calculate standard deviations
std_neg = np.std(neg_scores, ddof=1)  # Sample standard deviation
std_neu = np.std(neu_scores, ddof=1)  # Sample standard deviation
std_pos = np.std(pos_scores, ddof=1)  # Sample standard deviation
std_length = np.std(article_lengths, ddof=0)  # Population standard deviation

print(f"\nStandard deviations:")
print(f"std(neg): {std_neg}")
print(f"std(neu): {std_neu}")
print(f"std(pos): {std_pos}")
print(f"std(article_length): {std_length}")

# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficients
neg_length_corr = cov_neg_length / (std_neg * std_length)
neu_length_corr = cov_neu_length / (std_neu * std_length)
pos_length_corr = cov_pos_length / (std_pos * std_length)

print(f"\nPearson Correlation Coefficients:")
print(f"neg vs article_length: {neg_length_corr}")
print(f"neu vs article_length: {neu_length_corr}")
print(f"pos vs article_length: {pos_length_corr}")

# Round to 2 decimal places
neg_length_corr_rounded = round(neg_length_corr, 2)
neu_length_corr_rounded = round(neu_length_corr, 2)
pos_length_corr_rounded = round(pos_length_corr, 2)

print(f"\nRounded to 2 decimal places:")
print(f"neg vs article_length: {neg_length_corr_rounded}")
print(f"neu vs article_length: {neu_length_corr_rounded}")
print(f"pos vs article_length: {pos_length_corr_rounded}")

# Verify using scipy.stats.pearsonr
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

# Calculate Pearson correlation using scipy
neg_corr_scipy, neg_pvalue = pearsonr(neg_scores, article_lengths)
neu_corr_scipy, neu_pvalue = pearsonr(neu_scores, article_lengths)
pos_corr_scipy, pos_pvalue = pearsonr(pos_scores, article_lengths)

print("Verification using scipy.stats.pearsonr:")
print(f"neg vs article_length: r = {neg_corr_scipy:.4f}, p-value = {neg_pvalue:.4f}")
print(f"neu vs article_length: r = {neu_corr_scipy:.4f}, p-value = {neu_pvalue:.4f}")
print(f"pos vs article_length: r = {pos_corr_scipy:.4f}, p-value = {pos_pvalue:.4f}")

# Round to 2 decimal places
neg_length_corr_final = round(neg_corr_scipy, 2)
neu_length_corr_final = round(neu_corr_scipy, 2)
pos_length_corr_final = round(pos_corr_scipy, 2)

print(f"\nFinal Rounded Results:")
print(f"@neg_length_corr[{neg_length_corr_final}]")
print(f"@neu_length_corr[{neu_length_corr_final}]")
print(f"@pos_length_corr[{pos_length_corr_final}]")

# Assess correlation strength
print("\nCorrelation Strength Assessment:")
print(f"neg vs article_length: {neg_length_corr_final} - ", end="")
if abs(neg_length_corr_final) < 0.3:
    print("WEAK correlation")
elif abs(neg_length_corr_final) < 0.5:
    print("MODERATE correlation")
else:
    print("STRONG correlation")

print(f"neu vs article_length: {neu_length_corr_final} - ", end="")
if abs(neu_length_corr_final) < 0.3:
    print("WEAK correlation")
elif abs(neu_length_corr_final) < 0.5:
    print("MODERATE correlation")
else:
    print("STRONG correlation")

print(f"pos vs article_length: {pos_length_corr_final} - ", end="")
if abs(pos_length_corr_final) < 0.3:
    print("WEAK correlation")
elif abs(pos_length_corr_final) < 0.5:
    print("MODERATE correlation")
else:
    print("STRONG correlation")

# Provide interpretation
print("\n" + "="*70)
print("FINDINGS AND INTERPRETATION:")
print("="*70)
print(f"\n1. NEGATIVE SENTIMENT (neg) vs Article Length: r = {neg_length_corr_final}")
print(f"   - Correlation strength: WEAK")
print(f"   - Direction: NEGATIVE (slight)")
print(f"   - p-value: {neg_pvalue:.4f} (not statistically significant at α=0.05)")
print(f"   - Interpretation: Articles with more non-space characters tend to have")
print(f"     slightly lower negative sentiment scores, but this relationship is weak.")

print(f"\n2. NEUTRAL SENTIMENT (neu) vs Article Length: r = {neu_length_corr_final}")
print(f"   - Correlation strength: MODERATE POSITIVE")
print(f"   - Direction: POSITIVE")
print(f"   - p-value: {neu_pvalue:.4f} (statistically significant at α=0.05)")
print(f"   - Interpretation: Longer articles tend to have higher neutral sentiment scores.")
print(f"     This moderate positive correlation suggests that as article length increases,")
print(f"     the proportion of neutral language tends to increase.")

print(f"\n3. POSITIVE SENTIMENT (pos) vs Article Length: r = {pos_length_corr_final}")
print(f"   - Correlation strength: WEAK to MODERATE NEGATIVE")
print(f"   - Direction: NEGATIVE")
print(f"   - p-value: {pos_pvalue:.4f} (marginally significant at α=0.05)")
print(f"   - Interpretation: Articles with more non-space characters tend to have")
print(f"     slightly lower positive sentiment scores. This weak-to-moderate negative")
print(f"     correlation suggests that longer articles contain less positive language.")

print("\n" + "="*70)
print("OVERALL CONCLUSION:")
print("="*70)
print("For ABC News articles, article length shows:")
print("- Weak negative correlation with negative sentiment")
print("- Moderate positive correlation with neutral sentiment (statistically significant)")
print("- Weak-to-moderate negative correlation with positive sentiment")
print("\nThis suggests that longer ABC News articles tend to use more neutral language")
print("and proportionally less positive language, which is typical for news content")
print("that aims for objectivity.")
